stem.text: A cell has an electromotive force (e.m.f.) of $6\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $R$. An external resistor, also of resistance $R$, is connected across this cell, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a dashed box labelled cell contains a 6 V cell in series with a resistor labelled R. The cell is connected in a closed loop to a second resistor, labelled R, at the bottom of the circuit.

stem.text: Power $P$ is dissipated by the external resistor.
The cell is replaced by a different cell that has an e.m.f. of $6\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance.
What is the new power that is dissipated in the external resistor?
